faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RCM Sishu Bhawan recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the RCM Sishu Bhawan recruitment is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the RCM Sishu Bhawan Various Posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced for various posts under the RCM Sishu Bhawan recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for these posts must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the RCM Sishu Bhawan posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for all the posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the RCM Sishu Bhawan Various Posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates will range from Rs. 7944 to Rs. 23170 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for the RCM Sishu Bhawan recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from Under Matric (8th-10th) to Graduate degrees in various disciplines like Social Work, Sociology, LLB, Science, Arts, and specific diplomas.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RCM Sishu Bhawan recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Career Marking, Merit List preparation, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by RCM Sishu Bhawan.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the RCM Sishu Bhawan located?
faq.answer: RCM Sishu Bhawan is located in Kandhamal, Odisha, with the pincode 762101.
